text: Taking the one queued ticket (ticket-name gates). The dot case is already fixed on main; I'm now making the two name checks one rule so siblings and backslash names agree too.
Now the edits: one rule in `names.ts`, tests, and the LOGIC files.
Tests pass. Now I'll put the old check back for a moment to confirm the new tests actually catch the disagreement.
The framework only expects `undefined` from this function there, and the stricter rule still gives that. I'll run the framework suite anyway.
Exactly 8 daemon failures is the known case of a fresh worktree with no `dist/` (they return 503). I'll build and run the suite again.
All 1222 node tests pass now. The dashboard's vitest run has 532 failures; checking whether my change could cause them.
Those failures are all "null useState": two copies of React loaded, which comes from this worktree's linked `node_modules`. They can't come from a pure string function. Committing and publishing.
My memory has a rule against "Generated with Claude Code" footers on gemstack PRs, so I'm removing the one I just added.

I took the one queued ticket and opened PR #1783. It will merge on its own once its checks pass: https://github.com/framework/the-framework/pull/1783

**The ticket:** a ticket file can be named two ways, as a bare filename or as a `tickets/…` path. The two checks gave different answers for the same name. The case the ticket names (a name starting with a dot) was already fixed on main by #1761. Two other cases from the ticket's plan were still open:
- **Plan or claim files** (`.plan.md`, `.lock.md`): the path check accepted them and the bare check refused them. So a queue link to a plan counted as a ticket, and then `tickets show` refused it.
- **Names with a backslash**: same split.

**The fix:** the path check is now just `tickets/` followed by a name the bare check accepts, so the two can't disagree. It's in `packages/skill-tickets/src/names.ts`. I also updated `names.LOGIC.md` and `names.test.LOGIC.md` to describe the one rule.

**Tests:**
- New cases in `names.test.ts` for both checks, plus a test that both give the same answer for a list of names.
- With the old check put back, 3 tests fail, so they do catch the bug.
- skill-tickets: 48/48 pass. Framework node tests: 1222/1222 pass after a build (before the build, 8 server tests failed, as they do in a new worktree with nothing built).
- **Dashboard tests fail here:** 532 of the dashboard's 820 vitest tests fail with a "null useState" error, which means two copies of React are loaded in this worktree. A name-checking function can't cause that. The PR checks will show whether it also happens outside this worktree.

**Wrap-up:**
- The ticket is closed (which also released my claim), the queue entry is marked done, and the queue is now empty.
- I removed the "Generated with Claude Code" line from the PR description, since your notes say gemstack PRs shouldn't have it. The commit still ends with a `Co-Authored-By: Claude` line.
- My branch is `agent-ticket-name-forms-agree-2`, because the name without `-2` was already taken.
